items.detail: post_info.favorite column
items.old_path: src-electron/storage/sqlite.ts (createTable via db.exec) — NO favorite column
items.new_path: src-electron/storage/SqliteHelper.ts (createTables via prepared statements) — HAS favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
items.impact: If initDB() through sqlite.ts creates the table first, the favorite column is missing. SqliteHelper's init() may fail to add it since ALTER TABLE is not called. Favorite operations use article: API (toggleFavorite) but the column may not exist.
